title: When and How to Canonize: A Generalization Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2605.11008v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While invariant architectures are standard for processing symmetric data, there is growing interest in achieving invariance by applying group averaging or canonization to non-invariant backbones. However, the theoretical generalization properties of these alternative strategies remain poorly understood. We introduce a theoretical framework to analyze the generalization error of these methods by bounding their covering numbers. We establish a rigorous generalization hierarchy: the error bounds of canonized models are at best equal to the error bounds of structurally invariant and group-averaged models, and at worst equal to the bounds of non-invariant baselines. Furthermore, we show that there exist optimal canonizations which attain the optimal error bounds, and poor canonizations which attain the non-invariant error bounds, and that this depends on the regularity of the canonization. translated_title: 何时以及如何进行典范化：一个泛化视角的解读
translated_abstract: 虽然不变架构是处理对称数据的标准方法，但人们越来越关注通过对非不变主干网络应用群平均或典范化来实现不变性。然而，这些替代策略的理论泛化性质仍然知之甚少。我们引入了一个理论框架，通过约束这些方法的覆盖数来分析它们的泛化误差。我们建立了一个严格的泛化层次结构：典范化模型的误差界限至多等于结构不变模型和群平均模型的误差界限，最坏情况下则等于非不变基线模型的误差界限。此外，我们证明了存在能够达到最优误差界限的最优典范化，也存在只能达到非不变误差界限的糟糕典范化，而这取决于典范化的正则性。最后，我们将该框架应用于置换……
tldr: 本文通过覆盖数建立了泛化误差分析框架，证明典范化模型的泛化性能介于结构不变/群平均模型与非不变基线之间，且典范化本身的正则性决定了其能达到最优还是最差的误差界限。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a generalization analysis framework via covering numbers, showing that canonized models' error bounds lie between those of structurally invariant/group-averaged models and non-invariant baselines, and that the regularity of the canonization determines whether optimal or worst-case bounds are attained.
